source_integrity.duplicate_code_result: Unique IB close identity; OOB close variant is separate.

source_snapshot.procedure: Activate SOL OOB, derive example session ID LSB order, then raw 0x06 0x3c by IB and OOB; generic clear-logs pre-step.
source_snapshot.criteria: Command succeeds and session closes immediately.

historical_reviews.deepseek: PARTIAL misses target-session and destructive-action controls.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION / CHANGED with dedicated-session inventory, byte-order proof and post-close verification.
historical_reviews.related_source_cases: Get Session Info can verify identity but cannot authorize termination.
historical_reviews.v3_1: ED-35 preserves close action; ED-38 forbids retry.

original_test_intent: Close exactly one approved dedicated BMC session through IB and prove no other session or management access was affected.
original_method: Preserve raw 0x06/0x3c close, but identify the target from protected inventory, validate four-byte ID order, confirm before action and independently verify post-state.
manual_activity: Owner approves one dedicated session; operator confirms identity, byte order and independent recovery immediately before the single close.
safety_requirements: Never create SOL merely for discovery
agent_execution_scope: Verify target absent and others intact

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Correct not to run placeholders but incomplete on destructive session targeting.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Protected raw 0x06 0x3c only after exact dedicated-session and byte-order validation.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Capture full inventory, prove dedicated target and ID encoding, confirm, close once through IB, then compare inventory/BMC health/audit.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Removes unsafe SOL creation and credential exposure while preserving termination coverage.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: OOB-only close is not IB coverage.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Wrong or reused ID can terminate another operator or recovery path.

project_override_considerations: Alternate APIs require identical single-session targeting, path coverage and post-close evidence; bulk logout is not equivalent.

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The IB case tells the operator to create an OOB SOL session and also supplies an OOB close path, mixing setup/transport coverage and adding state that is unnecessary and unsafe for target discovery.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The close command and goal are clear; target, encoding, package and confirmation are execution-readiness controls.

review_improvement: Prevents termination of the wrong operator/recovery session and requires proof that only the approved target ended.
independent_technical_reasoning: Session close is destructive but precisely bounded when a dedicated target, four-byte identifier and independent recovery exist. It therefore requires a package and human confirmation, not permanent blocking or unattended automation.
